title: Critical RCE in public-facing nginx
description: Path traversal in legacy upload endpoint allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Public exploit available.
remediation_hint: Upgrade nginx to 1.27.x and patch legacy upload module

title: SQL injection in customer portal login
description: Boolean-based blind SQLi in `login.do` user field allows credential dump.
remediation_hint: Switch to parameterized queries; rotate all DB creds

title: Outdated TLS on payment gateway
description: TLS 1.0 enabled on PO supports TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1; PCI DSS non-compliant.
remediation_hint: Enforce TLS 1.2+ via nginx config; require PCI re-scan

title: Missing MFA on admin VPN
description: VPN console only allows remote console login; no MFA enforced for admins.
remediation_hint: Enable MFA for all admin VPN accounts

title: Default credentials on dev database
description: MongoDB on staging DB allows unauthenticated login with default admin/admin.
remediation_hint: Set auth

title: S3 bucket public read access
description: S3 bucket `acme-logs` allows `*` read; contains PII logs.
remediation_hint: Apply bucket policy restricting read to IAM role

title: Vulnerable OpenSSL on mail server (Heartbleed-class)
description: Affected by CVE-2014-0160 due to pinned legacy image.
remediation_hint: Rebuild image with patched openssl package

title: Cross-site scripting on marketing site
description: Stored XSS in blog comment field; session hijack possible.
remediation_hint: Sanitize input

title: Excessive permissions on GitHub org
description: Multiple non-admin accounts have admin role on acme github org.
remediation_hint: Reduce to least privilege; enable audit log

title: Unencrypted backup tapes in transit
description: Backup tapes shipped to offsite vendor in unencrypted form.
remediation_hint: Switch to encrypted LTO or cloud vault with KMS

title: Outdated WordPress on brochure site
description: WordPress 5.2 with multiple known plugin CVEs.
remediation_hint: Update WP to 6.6; remove unused plugins

title: Verbose error messages on internal API
description: Stack traces returned to clients expose internal paths.
remediation_hint: Disable debug mode in prod

title: Missing endpoint detection on dev laptops
description: Nova and Threva have access to the internet with no EDR.
remediation_hint: UNKNOWN
column14: Install EDR on all corporate laptops

title: Weak password policy on internal wiki
description: Wiki allows 4-char passwords; no complexity rules.
remediation_hint: Enforce 12+ chars and complexity

title: Open SMB share on file server
description: SMB share `\\filesrv\public` writable by Everyone.
remediation_hint: Restrict to specific group; audit contents

title: Duplicate of F-005 (dev-db default creds)
description: Same default credential issue reported by second scanner.
remediation_hint: Consolidate with F-005

title: DNS zone transfer allowed
description: AXFR open to internet on ns1.acme.local.
remediation_hint: Restrict AXFR to authorized secondaries

title: Jenkins server with no auth on internal net
description: Jenkins on port 8080 has no authentication.
remediation_hint: Enable matrix auth; require VPN group

title: Logging disabled on edge firewall
description: Logging disabled due to disk space issue; blind spot for incidents.
remediation_hint: Expand log disk or enable remote syslog

title: Hardcoded API key in mobile app binary
description: Stripe live key found in mobile app; should be restricted.
remediation_hint: Move to backend proxy with restricted key
